excerpts.author: chris2_2_2
excerpts.content: One problem with discussing the merge is we don't know how the network will look in the future. There will likely be competing PoW options that are much bigger than they are today.  I think to best promote security there needs to be a way to promote decentralization. Perhaps by limiting the blocks a pool can mine so that more hashrate beyond a certain amount doesn't = more income pre-merge. Micah had also suggested a random merge date which I thought was appealing (but also insane).

excerpts.author: Deleted User
excerpts.content: I'm just failing to see what will incentive GPU miners to continue mining the last 30 days before the merge. Without an incentive, the possibility of mostly ASICs mining at the end is a lot higher I would think. If you get $5/day per GPU, every day, what's the point of income the final 10-15 days if you are likely to have a hard time selling video cards at all post merge? I am not a miner and actually would start mining before the merge, but only to help protect the chain being decentralized, even though it likely serves little/no purpose.

excerpts.author: Deleted User
excerpts.content: doubt on a successful merge can also put a shadow over the eth price, thus reducing desire to mine (if hashrate reaches some standard equilibrium where a card is back to like $20-30/month instead of over 2-3 days)

excerpts.author: Deleted User
excerpts.content: anyhow, i just think it's worth considering what the merge would look like from the mining side and getting a clean transition

excerpts.content: We're told that currently only 10% of the network is asics (obviously up to you if you want to believe this #) and that due to the chip shortage this number is currently growing very slowly. So a quick EIP would nip this threat in the bud if approved. Sidechain is attractive especially if there's a difficulty bomb so that it slowly winds itself down. If the only real roadblock to asic domination is the chip shortage though then yes this 10% number could quickly increase assuming ETH prices are as high as today or higher.
